test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the following schemes in the ascending order of their discounts.

A. Buy 3 get 2 free.

B. A single discount of 65%.

C. Two successive discounts of 31% and 40%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Scheme A: Discount = 2 ÷ 5 × 100 = 40%

Scheme B: Discount = 65%

Scheme C: Discount = 31 + 40 − (31 × 40 ÷ 100) = 58.6%

Comparing discounts: 40% (A) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Scheme A = Buy 3 get 2 free

Scheme B = Single discount of 65%

Scheme C = Successive discounts of 31% and 40%

**Formula Used:**

1. Discount % (Buy x get y free) = [y ÷ (x + y)] × 100

2. Equivalent Single Discount for x% and y% = [x + y − (xy ÷ 100)]%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Discount % for Scheme A = [2 ÷ (3 + 2)] × 100

⇒ Discount % for Scheme A = (2 ÷ 5) × 100 = 40%

⇒ Discount % for Scheme B = 65%

⇒ Discount % for Scheme C = [31 + 40 − (31 × 40 ÷ 100)]%

⇒ Discount % for Scheme C = [71 − 1240 ÷ 100]% = 71 − 12.4 = 58.6%

⇒ Arranging in ascending order: 40% [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the equivalent single discount is given by (a + b − ab/100)%.

Buy X Get Y Free Concept

In this scheme, the customer gets (X + Y) items but pays only for X items. The discount percentage is calculated as [Free Items ÷ Total Items] × 100.

Successive Multiplier Method

For multiple successive discounts, the final Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × ... × (1 − dₙ/100).
